analysis.summary: SQLaw tests GPU-based DBMSs, which the authors say had received no systematic bug-detection effort despite growing interest. It combines offline rule learning, which automatically extracts differential execution rules used to guide synthesis of configurations and queries, with an online interpreter that mutates those statements to generalise them. Evaluated on three major GPU DBMSs it outperformed state-of-the-art approaches by up to 2.22x and detected 51 previously unknown GPU-related bugs, 37 confirmed or fixed.
